android.desc: Discover the songs that nearby users of Hot Music Nearby are listening to. ☆ An innovative, localized way to discover the best and most popular music near you. ☆ How near? City, State, Country - you choose the search radius. ☆ Most popular when? Discover the most played tracks in a day, a week, or a month. ☆ Premium feature: searching anywhere on the world.. Choose any location on the map and discover popular songs around the chosen location. ☆ We need your location to discover tracks played by other users nearby.
